findings.title: Valve Target Recommendation ships disabled where a mixing valve is set, and available-but-unknown where none is
findings.claim: In 5 of 5 golden topologies with mixing_valve_mode=manual, Valve Target Recommendation publishes a target (23.0 °C) and its reason while its registry default is off; in the same 5 topologies without a valve it is available with state unknown.
findings.mechanism: ValveTargetRecommendationSensor keeps a static _attr_entity_registry_enabled_default=False and the base availability, while the payload key it reads (coordinator._mixing_valve_view) exists only when mixing_valve.is_throttling(mode). Its sibling opt-in readouts take default and availability from the configured feature: ConfiguredInputMixin (ECL110, probes; #1302/#1542) and DHWEntityMixin (#1398). The class docstring's reason ('disabled rather than eternally-unknown') covers only the no-valve install, where the entity is nevertheless available.

evidence.unit: topologies (of 5) with a throttling valve where the entity publishes a value while enabled_default is False
evidence.machine: leads box L2: 4-core Linux cloud container, /home/claude/venv314 CPython
evidence.contention_note: leads fan-out: seats L1/L3/L4 on the same box; count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb valve: entity_registry_enabled_default follows mixing_valve.is_throttling(config mixing_valve_mode) (in memory)

findings.metric_definition: Topologies (of the 5 golden coordinator scenarios) with mixing_valve_mode=manual where the entity's native_value is not None and entity_registry_enabled_default is False.
findings.phenomenon_property: An entity whose value exists only under an opt-in configuration feature takes its registry default and its availability from that feature being configured, never from a static class attribute.
findings.seam_rule: grep -n '_attr_entity_registry_enabled_default = False' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/sensor.py custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/binary_sensor.py  (each hit checked against the payload gate its value needs)
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Gate ValveTargetRecommendationSensor's default and availability on mixing_valve.is_throttling(mode) in the ConfiguredInputMixin shape; update README.md:551/:560 and the disabled-set pins in tests/entities.py. Existing registry entries keep their state.
